grh_3818e6b91e6a712fe92b.title: The Nightmare
paragraphs: Janice is tormented by a recurring dream in which a red pickup crosses a highway divider, crashes into her car and kills her while 'As Time Goes By' plays on the radio. Her fear deepens when her mother reveals that she dreamed of Janice's father's grave shortly before his death, and ordinary red trucks and snatches of the song begin to feel like warnings. Janice withdraws from school and driving until a psychiatrist persuades her that the nightmare reflects anxiety and guilt rather than fate. Determined to reclaim her life, she finally drives alone to meet her husband and watches in terror as a red pickup approaches, swerves and safely passes. She reaches him convinced the danger is over, and they plan a weekend drive to Carmel, but the episode closes with 'As Time Goes By' playing again on the radio.

grh_382f9e0de7dd732fc63c.title: The Seeing Eye Pt1
paragraphs: An automobile accident leaves accomplished young musician Peg Foster blind, and the pity of her mother and fiance Joe Hardy soon makes her feel helpless and incapable of the life she had planned. Dr. Christian argues that their loving dependence is doing more harm than the blindness itself and persuades Peg to attend the Seeing Eye school in Morristown, New Jersey. When the training becomes difficult and Peg wants to quit, he deliberately challenges her pride until she stays. She returns home independently with her guide dog Mara, able to travel on her own and ready to resume the active life, music and future she feared she had lost.
